breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states the factor-of-safety condition as 'P_cr ≥ n·P', which matches the ground truth. The incorrect condition from the incomplete prompt ('P_cr ≥ P/n') has been removed and replaced with the proper design requirement that the critical load must exceed n times the applied load.
